mechanism.mechanism_of_action: PARP inhibitor that blocks DNA repair in cells with BRCA mutations, causing synthetic lethality in tumor cells with defective DNA repair pathways

clinical.indications: Ovarian cancer, breast cancer (with BRCA mutation), pancreatic cancer, prostate cancer (with BRCA mutation), gastric cancer

market.market_position: First approved PARP inhibitor, blockbuster status [uncertain]
